embeds.title: 🔨  Guild Board updates itself now
embeds.description:
Guild Board is live on CurseForge. Install it once from the app and every update lands on its own, bug fixes included. No more zips.

**1.** Open the CurseForge app and pick your WoW Forever install
**2.** Search **Push To Prod: Guild Board** (there is another addon just called Guild Board, that one is not ours)
**3.** Hit Install, then fully restart WoW

Already have it from GitHub? Install it from the app anyway so it takes over the updates.

**[Push To Prod: Guild Board on CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/push-to-prod-guild-board)**

footer: Something busted? Type /gb bug in game  ·  For the Horde
